ingameEffects.label: Punishment (W-Engine Passive)
ingameEffects.description: While off-field, Energy Regen increases. Attacks from the equipper increase all units' DMG against a struck target for 3 seconds. During this period, this effect is further increased every 0.5s, up to a maximum additional increase. Repeated triggers only refresh its duration without refreshing the DMG increase effect. Passive effects of the same name do not stack.
ingameEffects.shortDescription: The equipper's Energy Regen is increased while off-field.
